prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on what you need, your budget, your industry, and whether you want local boutique attention or a big-agency scale.

To help you find the best fit, tell me a little about:
- Your goals (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, SEO, social, etc.)
- Your budget range (monthly or campaign)
- Timeline (ongoing retainer vs a single campaign)
- Industry (B2B, B2C, nonprofit, healthcare, retail, etc.)
- Whether you prefer a local agency or don’t mind a national shop

If you want a quick starting point, here’s a practical approach and a couple of well-known KC agencies to consider:

How to choose
- Define clear goals and KPIs up front.
- Look for case studies and measurable results, not just awards.
- Check client list and industry experience.
- Ask about reporting cadence and what metrics they’ll own.
- Request references and ask about team continuity.
- Compare pricing models (retainer, project, performance-based).
- Start with a small test project if you’re unsure.

Resources to find & vet agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity for client reviews and categories
- Kansas City Business Journal and Ad Age lists for local reputations
- LinkedIn for agency team background and client posts
- Ask peers in your industry for referrals

Examples of notable Kansas City agencies
- VML (now VMLY&R) — a large global/full-service agency with strong digital and brand capabilities and Kansas City roots
- Barkley — a prominent independent creative agency based in KC known for strategy and big-brand creative work

(There are many strong local boutiques and performance shops that are better fits for smaller budgets or specialized work; I avoided listing them all so I don’t steer you toward the wrong match.)

If you share the details above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Kansas City agencies matched to your needs and give a recommended first-contact script and RFP checklist. Which direction do you want to go?
